title: Predicted & Trending Questions
notes: Practice items on recent laws and topics likely to appear in upcoming CSE-PPT schedules. These are predictions based on the published exam coverage, not leaked questions.

questions.q: Which law replaced the Government Procurement Reform Act (RA 9184) in 2024?
c: RA 11032 – Ease of Doing Business Act
questions.x: RA 12009, the New Government Procurement Act (2024), repealed and replaced RA 9184 (2003). It modernizes public procurement with tools like e-marketplaces and more procurement methods.

questions.q: The law requiring the registration of all SIM cards in the Philippines is:
questions.x: RA 11934, the SIM Registration Act (2022), requires end-users to register their SIMs to curb text and online scams. RA 10175 is the Cybercrime Prevention Act; RA 11055 is the PhilSys Act; RA 10173 is the Data Privacy Act.

questions.q: The Philippine Identification System (PhilSys), or the national ID, was established by:
questions.x: RA 11055 (2018), the Philippine Identification System Act, created a single national ID for all citizens and resident aliens, administered by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

questions.q: The Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Act of 2022 (RA 11898) mainly requires large enterprises to:
c: Recover or offset their plastic packaging waste
Plant trees for every product sold
Stop all use of plastic immediately
Pay a carbon tax on electricity
questions.x: RA 11898 amended RA 9003 and requires large enterprises to take responsibility for the plastic packaging waste of their products through recovery, recycling or offsetting, with targets that increase each year.

questions.q: RA 11313, which penalizes gender-based sexual harassment in streets, public spaces, online and workplaces, is popularly known as the:
questions.x: RA 11313 (2019) is the Safe Spaces Act, or "Bawal Bastos" Law. It expands RA 7877 (1995), which covered only work, education and training settings.

questions.q: The Philippine Mental Health Act is:
questions.x: RA 11036 (2018) is the Mental Health Act. RA 11058 is the Occupational Safety and Health law; RA 11223 is the Universal Health Care Act; RA 11165 is the Telecommuting Act.

questions.q: Under the Universal Health Care Act (RA 11223), who are automatically included in the National Health Insurance Program?
questions.x: RA 11223 (2019) automatically enrolls every Filipino citizen in the National Health Insurance Program administered by PhilHealth.

questions.q: RA 11648 (2022) raised the age of sexual consent in the Philippines from 12 to:
questions.x: RA 11648 raised the age for determining statutory rape from under 12 to under 16.

questions.q: The law that prohibits and declares illegal the practice of child marriage is:
questions.x: RA 11596 (2021) prohibits child marriage, meaning any marriage where one or both parties are below 18, and penalizes those who facilitate or officiate it.

questions.q: The Expanded Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2022 is:
questions.x: RA 11862 (2022) further strengthened the anti-trafficking law. It amends RA 9208 (2003), which was first expanded by RA 10364 (2012). RA 11930 covers online sexual abuse and exploitation of children (OSAEC).

questions.q: The Expanded Solo Parents Welfare Act is:
questions.x: RA 11861 (2022) expanded the benefits of RA 8972 (2000). Benefits include a monthly cash subsidy for qualified low-income solo parents and 7 days of parental leave.

questions.q: Freedom of Information in the Executive Branch was operationalized through:
questions.x: Executive Order No. 2 (2016) operationalizes the people's constitutional right to information in the Executive Branch. There is still no FOI law covering all branches.

questions.q: The CSC program that empowers agencies to become centers of excellence in human resource management is:
questions.x: PRIME-HRM (Program to Institutionalize Meritocracy and Excellence in Human Resource Management) assesses and awards agencies on their HR systems. PhilGEPS is the procurement portal.

questions.q: Under PD 907, civil service eligibility is granted to college graduates who:
c: Graduated summa cum laude, magna cum laude or cum laude
Graduated with any degree within four years
Served in government for at least two years
questions.x: PD 907 grants the Honor Graduate Eligibility to graduates with Latin honors (summa, magna or cum laude) from a baccalaureate program. It is equivalent to a second-level eligibility.

questions.q: The Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps) was institutionalized by:
questions.x: RA 11310 (2019) made 4Ps, the conditional cash transfer program implemented by DSWD, a permanent national poverty-reduction program.

questions.q: The Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act (free college tuition in SUCs) is:
questions.x: RA 10931 (2017) provides free tuition and miscellaneous fees in state and local universities and colleges. RA 10533 is the K-to-12 law; RA 7722 created CHED.

questions.q: Which law promotes the development of the electric vehicle industry in the Philippines?
c: RA 11285 – Energy Efficiency and Conservation Act
questions.x: RA 11697 (2022), the Electric Vehicle Industry Development Act (EVIDA), sets the national framework for EVs and charging stations. RA 11285 (2019) covers energy efficiency; RA 9513 (2008) covers renewable energy.

questions.q: The Salary Standardization Law of 2019 (SSL V) is:
questions.x: RA 11466 (SSL V, 2019) provided salary increases for civilian government personnel in four tranches from 2020 to 2023. RA 6758 is the original 1989 Compensation and Position Classification Act.

questions.q: The Telecommuting Act (RA 11165) applies primarily to employees in the:
questions.x: RA 11165 (2018) allows private-sector employers to offer telecommuting (work-from-home) arrangements with the same rights and benefits as on-site workers. Government flexible work is governed by CSC rules.

questions.q: The Occupational Safety and Health Standards law, which strengthens compliance with OSH standards in workplaces, is:
questions.x: RA 11058 (2018) strengthens compliance with OSH standards and provides penalties for violations. RA 10911 (2016) prohibits age discrimination in employment.

questions.q:
Arrange the sentences to form a logical paragraph:
(1) As a result, many offices now accept online applications.
(2) The pandemic forced government agencies to rethink how they deliver services.
(3) Still, walk-in counters remain for citizens without internet access.
(4) Face-to-face transactions became risky and, at times, impossible.
questions.x: Start with the general topic (2), then the problem it caused (4), the result signaled by "As a result" (1), and the qualification signaled by "Still" (3). Transition words are the strongest clues.

questions.q: Neither of the two applicants ___ submitted the required documents.
questions.x: Neither used as a pronoun is singular, so it takes the singular verb has.

questions.q: Choose the word closest in meaning to PRAGMATIC.
questions.x: Pragmatic means dealing with things sensibly and realistically, based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

questions.q: A government employee's monthly salary increased from ₱27,000 to ₱29,700. What is the percent increase?
questions.x:
Increase = 29,700 − 27,000 = 2,700.
Percent increase = 2,700 ÷ 27,000 × 100 = 10%.
(Dividing by the new salary gives 9.09%, a common trap.)

questions.q: An encoder can type 1,200 records in 8 hours. A second encoder types 1,200 records in 12 hours. Working together, how long will they take to encode 1,200 records?
A municipality's budget of ₱80 million is 35% for social services, 25% for infrastructure, and the rest for general services. How much goes to general services?
questions.x:
General services = 100% − 35% − 25% = 40%.
40% of ₱80 million = 0.40 × 80 = ₱32 million.

questions.q: All permanent employees are entitled to leave credits. Jose is entitled to leave credits. Which conclusion is valid?
c: No definite conclusion can be drawn about whether Jose is permanent.
Jose is not a permanent employee.
All employees with leave credits are permanent.
questions.x: The statement goes one way only: permanent → leave credits. Jose having leave credits doesn't prove he is permanent, since others such as temporary employees may also earn them. Concluding he is permanent would be affirming the consequent.

questions.q: Pumasok siya sa opisina ___ maaga upang tapusin ang ulat.
questions.x: Use nang to introduce an adverb of manner or time that describes the verb: "pumasok nang maaga" (came in early).

questions.q: Under the Data Privacy Act, a clerk who receives personal data from an applicant should:
c: Use it only for its declared purpose and keep it secure
Share it with co-workers who ask for it
Post it on the office bulletin board
Keep a personal copy for future reference
questions.x: The Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) requires personal data to be processed only for declared, legitimate purposes and protected with reasonable security measures. Sharing or posting it without basis is a violation.

questions.q: The Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020, which repealed the Human Security Act of 2007, is:
questions.x: RA 11479 is the Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020. It repealed RA 9372 (Human Security Act of 2007). RA 11469 is the Bayanihan to Heal as One Act (2020).
